01-04 · Product

Four things, done properly.

01

Cards with rules baked in

Issue virtual and physical cards with limits, categories, and merchant locks set before the first swipe. Policy is enforced at the terminal, not in a PDF nobody reads.

02

Receipts match themselves

Forward an email or snap a photo. Konto reads the merchant, amount, and VAT, then pairs it to the transaction on its own. Missing one? The spender gets the nudge, not you.

03

Approvals that route themselves

Amount, team, and category decide who signs off. Approvers act from Slack or email in one click, and every decision is logged for the auditor you hope never calls.

04

Exports your accountant will love

DATEV, Xero, QuickBooks, or plain CSV with VAT split and cost centers intact. The month closes reconciled, not approximately.
